decisions.reason: The small hierarchical search plugin has not appeared on the website since 2018, which suggests weak results against aspirations, so its resources are better used for the platform and core business.
As the flagship platform defining the firm's strategic direction, it stays committed even though its absence from the website may only reflect a rebranding or integration.
Mobile field data capture meets core customer needs in a growing market, and slack lets the firm carry it despite its lower visibility.
The search extension overlaps with the other search functions, has not been visible since 2018, and is likely to be folded into the platform, freeing resources for new development.
